Senses.Explanation: Unable to save oneself is an adverse verdict on a position that cannot carry its holder through the present test. Chaozong Huifang applies it to resting in “not obscuring causality,” Linji Yixuan makes it the result of attaining only the third phrase, and Deshan Xuanjian applies it to conventional holy ranks. Later commentators use it against readings of the cat case and against inherited verse.
